# Security Policy

Security fixes go into the latest release only. Upgrade with `workboard upgrade` before reporting.

Report vulnerabilities privately at **<https://github.com/Paliverse/workboard/security/advisories/new>**, never in a public issue or pull request. Include:

- the version and install channel (`workboard version`) and your operating system;
- what an attacker needs (for example, a web page you visit or another local account);
- steps to reproduce, and the impact you observed.

You'll get a reply within a week. Once a fix ships, the advisory is published with credit to you, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.

What WorkBoard defends against, and what is out of scope, is described in the [security model](../docs/architecture.md#security-model).
